title: Brian Balfour on the Four Growth Fits, Funnels vs. Loops, and Scaling Products Beyond $100M ARR
guest_title: Founder & CEO of Reforge, former VP Growth at HubSpot

segments.speaker: Lenny Rachitsky
segments.text: Brian, welcome! Reforge has transformed how product and growth leaders think. One of your foundational concepts is the Four Fits framework. Why isn't Product-Market Fit alone enough for a venture-scale company?

segments.speaker: Brian Balfour
segments.text: Product-Market Fit is essential, but it is not sufficient. You don't build products in isolation; you build them within an ecosystem. You need four fits working in harmony: 1) Market-Product Fit: Validating that a real market problem exists and your product solves it. 2) Product-Channel Fit: Products are built for channels, channels are not built for products. For example, virality fits consumer social, SEO fits intent-driven search, sales fits enterprise. 3) Channel-Model Fit: Your ARPU (Average Revenue Per User) determines which channels you can afford. Low ARPU requires free viral or SEO channels; high ARPU supports direct enterprise sales reps. 4) Model-Market Fit: Your pricing model multiplied by market size must yield a venture-scale outcome.

segments.speaker: Brian Balfour
segments.text: The key insight is that these four fits are co-dependent and constantly shifting. If you change your product features or pricing model, you inevitably break your channel fit or market fit. Scaling requires constantly recalibrating all four fits together.
